def extract_grid(txt, label):
 m=re.search(rf'{label} \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n)+)',txt)
 if not m: raise ValueError(label)
 h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2)); rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
 assert len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows),(h,w,len(rows),[len(r) for r in rows])
 return rows
def trans(g):
 n=len(g)
 cw=[[g[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
 ccw=[[g[c][n-1-r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
 rot180=[row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]
 return [a+b for a,b in zip(g,cw)] + [a+b for a,b in zip(ccw,rot180)]
for t in usertexts:
